variations-description: Inputs share the same rounded container, focus ring, and helper text placement shown in the design reference.
validation-description: Inputs display an error border and helper copy when a validation message exists.
phone-description: Combines the text-field styling with a country selector that defaults to +62 but is easy to extend.
select-description: Use the same rounded border, focus ring, and helper alignment for dropdowns.
searchable-description: Multiselect dropdown can fetch search results and create missing options via RTK Query.
searchable-helper: Type to search, and add a new option if no result is returned
checkables-description: Keep helper text aligned under the group and use the same tokens for disabled states.
label: Label
quantity-helper: Shows thousand separators while keeping the raw numeric value in onChange
budget-helper: Uses IDR formatting by default when currency mode is enabled
helper-with-error: Helper text combined with the error state
